title: Dream a Little Dream of Me | Tutorial & Technical Exercise Ideas (2020)
description: This is a very simple piece to learn so I use it to give a few ideas of LH/RH styles which can be applied to other jazzy repertoire.The chord progression for Section A1/A2, as demonstrated and reinforced, is: A) I / biii(dim) / bVI7 / V7... I, VII7, VI7 // B) IV7 / iv7 / I / bVI7 / V.  Section B:  (floating off the b6):  I / vi7 / ii7 / V7 / repeat 3 times.. then I / vi / back to master key's V7 and start again.
